<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">Number of clock cycles for division operation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="phase_clk" width_description="[1:0]">Phase shifted clock signals.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter value.</signal>
        <signal id="even_cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Evenly divided counter value.</signal>
        <signal id="odd_cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Oddly divided counter value.</signal>
        <signal id="clk_div_tmp">Temporary divided clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="clk_div_tmp2">Second temporary divided clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="clk_div_tmp3">Third temporary divided clock signal.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Phase shifting logic
        assign phase_clk[0] = ~clk;
        assign phase_clk[1] = clk;
        
        // Counter logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else if (cnt == MUL2_DIV_CLK - 1) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Evenly divided counter logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                even_cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else if ((cnt % 2 == 0 && cnt != 0) || cnt == 4'd0) begin
                even_cnt <= even_cnt + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Oddly divided counter logic
        always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                odd_cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else if ((cnt % 2 == 1 && cnt != 0) || cnt == 4'd0) begin
                odd_cnt <= odd_cnt + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Temporary divided clock generation logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                clk_div_tmp <= 1'b0;
            end else if (cnt >= 4'd0 && cnt <= 4'd3) begin
                clk_div_tmp <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                clk_div_tmp <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
        
        // Second temporary divided clock generation logic
        always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                clk_div_tmp2 <= 1'b0;
            end else if (cnt >= 4'd0 && cnt <= 4'd2) begin
                clk_div_tmp2 <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                clk_div_tmp2 <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
        
        // Third temporary divided clock generation logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                clk_div_tmp3 <= 1'b0;
            end else if (cnt >= 4'd0 && cnt <= 4'd4) begin
                clk_div_tmp3 <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                clk_div_tmp3 <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
        
        // Final divided clock output logic
        assign clk_div = clk_div_tmp | clk_div_tmp2 | clk_div_tmp3;
    </implementation>
</module>
